adaptation_en: Microsoft added official iPhone Duo support in Outlook 5.2641.0 (Oct 23, 2026): the app fills the inner display with no letterboxing, resizes smoothly, and supports side-by-side multitasking. The headline two-pane layout (inbox next to a full message) has NOT shipped yet — Apple says it rolls out 'in the coming weeks.' Partial adaptation; re-check pending.
adaptation_zh: 微软在 Outlook 5.2641.0（2026 年 10 月 23 日）加入了官方 iPhone Duo 支持：展开铺满内屏、无黑边、布局切换平滑、支持与其它 App 并排分屏。但最关键的双栏布局（左侧收件箱 + 右侧整封邮件）尚未上线——苹果官方称将在「未来几周」推出。属部分适配，待复核。
highlights: Official Duo support shipped on launch day (5.2641.0, Oct 23, 2026)
Fills the inner display, no letterboxing; smoother resizing
Two-pane inbox + full message NOT live yet — Apple: 'in the coming weeks'
source_name: Microsoft Learn: Release notes for Outlook Mobile (5.2641.0, 2026-10-23)
